chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ibn Sinan, who said: I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying:
The Ziyarat (visitation) of the grave of Husayn (peace be upon him) is equal to an accepted Umrah.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn according to Imam Ridha?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, Imam al-Rida (a.s.) equates the reward of visiting Imam Husayn’s grave with an accepted Umrah, emphasizing the unique spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia theology. This comparison underscores that Ziyarat is not merely a physical visit but a profound act of devotion that carries the weight of a major pilgrimage, reflecting the deep connection between the Imams and the divine presence.
